# Aladdin's Lamp and Other Oriental Tales: Illustrated Children's Fairy Stories by Tony Wolf

## Dive into a World of Magic with Litera Books

Bring the magic of ancient folklore to your child's bedside table with this beautifully illustrated collection of **Aladdin's Lamp and other Oriental tales**. From the beloved brand Litera, these stories capture the enchanting spirit of childhood through vibrant colors and whimsical lines. Perfect for sparking imagination, this book invites young readers (and adults!) into a richly imagined world of adventure and wonder.

These expertly curated fairy tales are designed to be engaging from the very first look. The included illustrations by celebrated Italian artist Tony Wolf breathe life into every page, making it a captivating experience whether your child is just beginning to read or relishing a nostalgic bedtime story.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book suitable for very young children?**
Yes. The collection is noted for being visually engaging, making it enjoyable for children to look through and listen to, even before they attain reading skills.

**Are the stories simply about Aladdin?**
No. While featuring Aladdin's Lamp prominently, the volume includes a variety of "other oriental tales," offering a broader scope of mythical adventure.

**Who is the illustrator for this book?**
The beautiful and magical illustrations were created by celebrated Italian artist Tony Wolf.
